_note: Settings for this booth. Branding (name, logo, colours, wording, consent) is in brand/brand.json, not here. Most values below are set in the recorder (Settings > Save settings, and Where clips are saved > Apply), which writes this file. 'launcher' is read by the start scripts: port and chromeApp only. 'storage' says where clips are saved: this laptop ('local'), another folder ('custom'), or a Google Drive for desktop account (location 'My Drive' or 'Shared drives/<name>'), plus a backup on a USB stick, a folder, or none. On Linux, add storage.sync to upload with rclone, see the README. The camera choice is not stored here (it differs per computer).
